description.en: Animated SVG charts designed specifically for shadcn/ui with minimal weight.
description.zh: 专为 shadcn/ui 定制的轻量级 SVG 动效图表库，由 Evil Martians 团队设计。

content.en: Evil Charts is an expressive, ultra-lightweight SVG chart library created by Evil Martians. Tailored to drop into shadcn/ui projects without heavy chart framework baggage, it delivers crisp line charts, glowing gradients, animated tooltips, and bar visualizations with pure SVG and CSS animations.
content.zh: Evil Charts 是由著名设计咨询团队 Evil Martians 出品的超轻量级 SVG 动效图表库。它专为 shadcn/ui 体系量身定制，彻底摆脱了传统庞大图表库的包体积负担，利用极简的 SVG 几何计算与 CSS 动效，呈现出发光折线图、平滑面积图与精致的数据悬浮提示框。
